half_residuals.definition: observed scoring rate minus predicted scoring probability; positive means scoring underpredicted
half_residuals.conclusion: Bottom-half scoring is underpredicted in all five seasons; top-half residual direction is unstable.

start_slot.finding: I2 start-slot distribution is modal at lineup slot 4 for every evaluated half; expected-slot residual correlations are tiny and inconsistent.

player_support.finding: Batter and pitcher training-support residual slopes are small and change sign across seasons; no stable sparse-support residual structure.

park_environment.finding: Bottom-half residual-versus-park-effect slope is negative in every season, suggesting current environmental effect magnitude may be too strong for bottom-half marginal scoring.

joint_half_dependence.definition: observed P(top scoreless and bottom scoreless) minus product of observed half scoreless marginals
joint_half_dependence.finding: Sign is unstable, so no fixed pregame dependence correction is justified.

decision: Do not add a half-specific, start-slot, support, park-magnitude, or joint-dependence residual correction to the lean candidate. Bottom-half marginal bias is diagnostically real but the available correction fails the actual full-I2 replication gate.

next_phase.name: Phase 30 direct-model hyperparameter audit
next_phase.objective: Re-evaluate regularization strength and recency weighting for the completed lean architecture against the actual full-I2 target rather than relying on upstream PA-event selection.
next_phase.rule: Precommit grid and selection policy before refitting; 2022-2025 development, 2026 replication only; production unchanged.
